title: launch runs the missed-SessionEnd catch-up before it marks its own session, and takes the first transcript glob hit
goal: Found in the SP-owbgisoj review (BG-ay4w32jc): on SessionEnd, ql_distill.launch globs and tail-reads every open spool session and may start up to 8 distills before it touches the ending session's own .end marker, inside the hook's time budget, so a kill leaves the session unmarked until a later launch; and kbusage.find_transcript takes the first unsorted glob hit across project directories, so a resumed session copied under a second project directory may read a stale transcript. launch touches its own marker first, and find_transcript prefers the newest matching transcript.

run: import inspect,sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import ql_distill as d;s=inspect.getsource(d.launch);i=s.find(".touch()");j=s.find("missed_ends(");ok=0<=i<j;print("launch marks its own session before the catch-up:",ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

repro_reason: a kill inside the SessionEnd budget cannot be staged in a check; the repro reads the order of the two steps in launch
